haiku.problem: The question says the tribes met "to renew their promise to the LORD," which Joshua 24:1 does not state. The verse says only that they were assembled at Shechem and presented themselves before God. This adds a purpose that the lesson's verses don't give.
The question repeats "serve the LORD," which is part of the right answer "You are not able to serve the LORD." The question holds a form of its own answer, so the right answer stands out.
